sections.content: All 34 manifest sources are present with complete single-page coverage and accepted bounded summaries. No source or page coverage is omitted.
sections.title: Coverage

sections.content: The sources define strict non-authorizing workflows for typed skill input, knowledge selection, TDD execution, lifecycle control, evidence ownership, validation, retention, and publication separation.
sections.title: Governance

sections.content: The toolchain plan covers source selection, transport, coverage, knowledge gates, immutable generations, retention safeguards, and end-to-end validation. Outputs remain bounded and redacted.
